dictionary_terms.label: Tax Lot
dictionary_terms.description: A type of legal description for land in developed areas where streets or other rights-of-ways delineate large parcels of land referred to as divided into lots on which homes or other types of developments are built. An example would read "Lot 12 of Block 45 of Tract 3002 of the City of San Dunes, Desert County." Such a description would also reference an official plat filed with the clerk or recorder for that area which shows the location of the block and often the dimensions of the lots therein.

dictionary_terms.label: Tax Year
dictionary_terms.description: The year in which the last assessment of the property value/tax was made.

dictionary_terms.label: Tax Block

An example would read "Lot 12 of Block 45 of Tract 3002 of the City of San Dunes, Desert County." dictionary_terms.label: Tax Tract

dictionary_terms.label: Close Date
dictionary_terms.description: With for-sale listings, this is the date the purchase agreement was fulfilled. With lease listings, it is the date the requirements were fulfilled, such as contract and/or deposit. This is the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS.

dictionary_terms.label: Elevation
dictionary_terms.description: The elevation of the property in relation to sea level. Use the Elevation Units field to communicate the unit of measurement (i.e., feet, meters).

dictionary_terms.label: Feed Types
dictionary_terms.description: A list of feeds that the given record is included in.

dictionary_terms.label: Height Unit
dictionary_terms.description: A pick list of the unit of measurement for height (e.g., Feet, Meters).

dictionary_terms.label: Down Payment
dictionary_terms.description: The down payment amount required by the current owner of the property.

dictionary_terms.label: Lot Size Area
dictionary_terms.description: The total area of the lot. See Lot Size Units for the units of measurement (e.g., square feet, square meters, acres).

dictionary_terms.label: Ongoing Fees
dictionary_terms.description: A pick list of the regularly recurring fees and costs paid by the lessee.

dictionary_terms.label: Lot Size Units
dictionary_terms.description: A pick list of the unit of measurement for the area (e.g., Square Feet, Square Meters, Acres).

dictionary_terms.label: Tax Map Number
dictionary_terms.description: Some systems of parcel identification incorporate a method that utilizes a county identifier, a tax book number, a tax map number and a parcel identification number.

dictionary_terms.label: Air Rights Unit
dictionary_terms.description: A pick list of the unit of measurement of vertical space extending above the commercial property (e.g., Square Feet, Square Meters).

dictionary_terms.label: Lease Rate Unit
dictionary_terms.description: The unit of measurement used to calculate the LeaseRate (e.g., Square Feet, Square Meters, Acres).

dictionary_terms.label: Tax Book Number
dictionary_terms.description: Some systems of parcel identification incorporate a method that utilizes a county identifier, a tax book number, a tax map number and a parcel identification number.

dictionary_terms.label: Association Fee
dictionary_terms.description: A fee paid by the homeowner to the homeowner association that is used for upkeep of common areas, the neighborhood or other association-related benefits.

dictionary_terms.label: Elevation Units
dictionary_terms.description: A pick list of the unit of measurement used in the Elevation field (i.e., Feet, Meters).

dictionary_terms.label: Mobile Dimensions Units
dictionary_terms.description: A pick list of the unit of linear measurement (e.g., Feet, Meters, Yards, Kilometers, Miles).

dictionary_terms.label: Association Fee 2
dictionary_terms.description: A fee paid by the homeowner to the second of two homeowner associations that is used for upkeep of common areas, the neighborhood or other association-related benefits.

dictionary_terms.label: Living Area Units
dictionary_terms.description: A pick list of the unit of measurement for the area (e.g., Square Feet, Square Meters).

dictionary_terms.label: New Taxes Expense
dictionary_terms.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

subareas.label: Leasing and Occupancy Management
subareas.description: Lease economics, tenancy, occupancy, vacancy and rental lifecycle.

dictionary_terms.label: Zoning
dictionary_terms.description: A division of the city or county into areas of different permissible land uses. This field should be used for the short code that is commonly used. For full textual descriptions, please use the ZoningDescription field.

dictionary_terms.label: Cap Rate
dictionary_terms.description: The equivalent to the return on investment you would receive if you pay cash for a property. The ratio between the net operating income produced by an asset and its capital cost (the original price paid to buy the asset) or alternatively its current market value.

dictionary_terms.label: Close Date
dictionary_terms.description: With for-sale listings, this is the date the purchase agreement was fulfilled. With lease listings, it is the date the requirements were fulfilled, such as contract and/or deposit. This is the date entered by the agent reflecting when the change occurred contractually, not a timestamp of when the change was made in the MLS.

dictionary_terms.label: Furnished
dictionary_terms.description: The property being leased is furnished, unfurnished or partially furnished.

dictionary_terms.label: Lease Rate
dictionary_terms.description: The amount of money paid over a specified unit of time as indicated in the LeaseRateFrequency and LeaseRateUnits fields.

dictionary_terms.label: Lease Term
dictionary_terms.description: A pick list of lengths that represent the length of the lease (e.g., Weekly, Month to Month, 6-Month Lease, 12-Month Lease, 2-Year Lease).

dictionary_terms.label: List Price
dictionary_terms.description: The current price of the property as determined by the seller and the seller's broker. For auctions, this is the minimum or reserve price.

dictionary_terms.label: Owner Pays
dictionary_terms.description: A list of expenses for the property paid for by the owner as opposed to the tenant (e.g., Water, Trash, Electric).

dictionary_terms.label: Ownership
dictionary_terms.description: A text description of the manner in which title to a property is held (e.g., Trust, Corporation, Joint Tenant, Individual).

dictionary_terms.label: Utilities
dictionary_terms.description: A list of the utilities for the property being sold/leased.

dictionary_terms.label: Year Built
dictionary_terms.description: The year that an occupancy permit is first granted for the house or other local measure of initial habitability of the build. The type of definition permits an empty value with an attribute noting that it is an unknown date or that the building is new construction. While constraints have not been applied, convention at the time of adoption has this as a four-digit year value.

dictionary_terms.label: Appliances
dictionary_terms.description: A list of the appliances that will be included in the sale/lease of the property.

dictionary_terms.label: Current Use
dictionary_terms.description: A list of the type(s) of current use of the property. The current use of the property is an important factor in understanding the overall condition of the land and determining appropriateness for intended use.

dictionary_terms.label: Postal City
dictionary_terms.description: The official city per the U.S. Postal Service (USPS), which may be different from the recorded city.

dictionary_terms.label: Sublease Yes/No
dictionary_terms.description: Indicates whether or not a sublease is available for the property.

dictionary_terms.label: Tenant Pays
dictionary_terms.description: A list of services or items that the tenant is responsible to pay.

dictionary_terms.label: Tenant Type
dictionary_terms.description: A pick list describing the current status of tenants or lack of tenants at the property.

dictionary_terms.label: Down Payment
dictionary_terms.description: The down payment amount required by the current owner of the property.

dictionary_terms.label: Fuel Expense
dictionary_terms.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

dictionary_terms.label: Gross Income
dictionary_terms.description: The actual current income from rent and all other revenue-generating sources.

dictionary_terms.label: Land Lease Yes/No
dictionary_terms.description: The land is not included in the sale and a lease exists.

dictionary_terms.label: Lease Amount
dictionary_terms.description: The amount of any lease the business pays for its current location.

dictionary_terms.label: Lot Features
dictionary_terms.description: A list of features or a description of the lot included in the sale/lease.

dictionary_terms.label: Move-in Costs
dictionary_terms.description: A pick list of the types upfront costs, both refundable and non-refundable, associated with the property being leased.

dictionary_terms.label: Pets Allowed
dictionary_terms.description: Indicates whether or not pets are allowed at the property being leased, usually as a list of yes, no and more detailed restrictions/allowances.

dictionary_terms.label: Pool Expense
dictionary_terms.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

dictionary_terms.label: Spa Features
dictionary_terms.description: A list of features or a description of the spa included in the sale/lease.

dictionary_terms.label: Tenant Names
dictionary_terms.description: The names of the tenant(s) that currently reside at the property.

dictionary_terms.label: Current Price
dictionary_terms.description: The present price or most recent price (for off-market statuses) of the listing, regardless of the status of the listing. For example, listings in Active, Expired or Closed status may all have a value in the CurrentPrice field.

dictionary_terms.label: Door Features
dictionary_terms.description: A list of features or description of the doors included in the sale/lease.

dictionary_terms.label: Leasable Area
dictionary_terms.description: The area that may be leased within the commercial property.

dictionary_terms.label: Listing Terms
dictionary_terms.description: Terms of the listing such as Lien Release, Subject to Court Approval or Owner Will Carry. Also may include options that describe the financing terms that are acceptable to the seller (i.e., Cash, Assumable, FHA, etc.).

dictionary_terms.label: Occupant Name
dictionary_terms.description: The name of the current occupant, if any, of the property being sold.

dictionary_terms.label: Occupant Type
dictionary_terms.description: A field that describes the type of occupant (i.e., Owner, Tenant, Vacant).

dictionary_terms.label: Other Expense
dictionary_terms.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

dictionary_terms.label: Pets Comments
dictionary_terms.description: A textual description for the pets allowance in the property being leased.

dictionary_terms.label: Pool Features
dictionary_terms.description: A list of features about or a description of a pool included in the sale/lease.

dictionary_terms.label: Property Type
dictionary_terms.description: A list of types of properties (e.g., Residential, Lease, Income, Land, Mobile, Commercial Sale).

dictionary_terms.label: Rent Includes
dictionary_terms.description: A list of services or items that the tenant is not responsible to pay.

dictionary_terms.label: Trash Expense
dictionary_terms.description: The annual expense that is not paid directly by the tenant and is included in the Operating Expense calculations.

dictionary_terms.label: Lease Rate Unit
dictionary_terms.description: The unit of measurement used to calculate the LeaseRate (e.g., Square Feet, Square Meters, Acres).

dictionary_terms.description: The equivalent to the return on investment you would receive if you pay cash for a property. The ratio between the net operating income produced by an asset and its capital cost (the original price paid to buy the asset) or alternatively its current market value.

dictionary_terms.label: Air Rights
dictionary_terms.description: The amount of vertical space extending above the commercial property.

dictionary_terms.label: Unit Types
dictionary_terms.description: A collection of types of units included in the income (multifamily) property. The collection includes a type, beds, baths and other aspects of the type of unit behind described.

dictionary_terms.label: Gross Income
dictionary_terms.description: The actual current income from rent and all other revenue-generating sources.

dictionary_terms.label: Other Income
dictionary_terms.description: The total of all other possible incomes for the property.

dictionary_terms.label: Property Type
dictionary_terms.description: A list of types of properties (e.g., Residential, Lease, Income, Land, Mobile, Commercial Sale).

dictionary_terms.label: Air Rights Unit
dictionary_terms.description: A pick list of the unit of measurement of vertical space extending above the commercial property (e.g., Square Feet, Square Meters).

dictionary_terms.label: Occupancy Rate
dictionary_terms.description: Indicates how much space of the property is occupied/leased compared to how much space is available.

dictionary_terms.label: Buyer Financing
dictionary_terms.description: A list of options that describe the type of financing used. This field is used when setting a listing to Closed (i.e., Cash, FHA Loan, etc.).

dictionary_terms.label: Income Includes
dictionary_terms.description: A list of income sources included in the GrossScheduledIncome and GrossIncome (e.g., Laundry, Parking, Recreation, Storage).

dictionary_terms.label: Pro Forma Cap Rate
dictionary_terms.description: The projected capitalization rate of a property based on its potential net operating income (NOI) rather than its current, actual performance.

dictionary_terms.label: Total Actual Rent
dictionary_terms.description: Total actual rent currently being collected from tenants of the income property.

dictionary_terms.label: Current Financing
dictionary_terms.description: A list of options that describe the type of financing that the seller currently has in place for the property being sold (i.e., Cash, FHA Loan, etc.).

dictionary_terms.label: Irrigation Source
dictionary_terms.description: The source which the property receives its water for irrigation.

dictionary_terms.label: Operating Expense
dictionary_terms.description: The costs associated with the operation and maintenance of an income-producing property.

dictionary_terms.label: Number Of Buildings
dictionary_terms.description: The total number of separate buildings included in the income property.

dictionary_terms.label: Net Operating Income
dictionary_terms.description: The net operating income is the revenue from a property after operating expenses have been deducted but before deducting income taxes and financing expenses (interest and principal payments). For example, gross income - operating expenses = net operating income (NOI).

dictionary_terms.label: Number Of Units Total
dictionary_terms.description: Total number of units included in the income property, occupied or unoccupied.

dictionary_terms.label: Financial Data Source
dictionary_terms.description: The source of the rental information (e.g., Accountant, Owner).

dictionary_terms.label: Gross Scheduled Income
dictionary_terms.description: The maximum amount of annual rent collected if the property were 100% occupied all year and all tenants paid their rent.

dictionary_terms.label: Irrigation Water Rights Yes/No
dictionary_terms.description: Indicates whether or not the property includes water rights for irrigation.

dictionary_terms.label: Irrigation Water Rights Acres
dictionary_terms.description: The number of acres allowed under the property's water rights.

dictionary_terms.label: Internet Automated Valuation Display Yes/No
dictionary_terms.description: Indicates whether or not the seller allows the listing to be displayed with an automated valuation model (AVM) on Internet sites.

dictionary_terms.label: Valuation reports
dictionary_terms.description: Valuation reports associated with the transaction

dictionary_terms.label: Valuation Comparison Data
dictionary_terms.description: A collection of data used to compare the valuations (market values) of properties in the real estate or property market.
